svg.title: EgoWorld: from egocentric video to structured annotations
svg.desc: A product overview with schematic examples of segmentation, a 21-joint human hand, a robotic hand, an object pose and a scene point cloud. RGB clips feed SAM2.1 with GroundingDINO and independently Fast3R. SAM hand boxes feed HaMeR; HaMeR joints feed DexRetarget. SAM object masks feed FoundationPose, which also requires aligned RGB-D, camera intrinsics and a metric mesh. DexRetarget requires a robot configuration and URDF. Every enabled stage writes structured outputs with quality checks and stage commit records. Examples are illustrations, not real model predictions; model coordinate frames are not fused.

g.text: E G O W O R L D / A N N O T A T I O N W O R K F L O W
From first-person video to usable annotations.
Hands, objects, robot joints and scene geometry — choose the outputs your data supports.
RGB is available to every visual stage
CPU preparation · GPU inference · CPU retargeting · asynchronous writes
Bounded scheduling and per-stage recovery; single-GPU and multi-GPU configurations.
K = camera intrinsics. Hand, object and scene outputs retain separate coordinate frames.
